sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: A track named differently from its recording (jesus2099's ≠ note) now says what kind of difference it is: the comparison box opens with a small label, Case only or Punctuation and spacing only (green; "&" counts as "and"), 1–2 characters (amber: a typo, a plural, an accent) or Different (red). The Title column's 📊 menu lists the same four kinds, indented under "≠ track/recording name", each with its count, so you can keep only the real differences. The punctuation fold and the edit distance follow majkinetor's Apollo Editor (recFold, recLev).

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Titles in MusicBrainz style (the Springsteen sites' converted titles and the title-style findings on MusicBrainz) now use MusicBrainz's own guess-case word lists, as majkinetor's Apollo Editor carries them: acronyms such as YMCA, USSR and NBA stay in capitals ("CORN IN THE USSR" becomes "Corn in the USSR", no longer "Corn in the Ussr"); iTunes, iPhone, iPad, iPod, iMac, YouTube, TikTok, DJs and OC ReMix are written that way whatever the source's case; and version phrases such as "official music video", "slowed", "sped up", "reverb" and "nightcore" count as extra title information, so "(Slowed + Reverb)" is written "(slowed + reverb)".
The title-style findings leave Armenian titles alone, as they already did Cyrillic and Greek ones: those scripts write titles in sentence case.
